instruction: The sidebar with slide previews is missing. Please make it visible again.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(5); pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('f10'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('right', presses=2, interval=0.1); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('down', presses=11, interval=0.1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: Task requires making the slide preview sidebar visible again. The evaluator checks for 'Slides View' presence in the accessibility tree.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses accessibility tree to verify sidebar visibility
Complete coverage: instruction requires sidebar visible, evaluator checks for 'Slides View' presence in accessibility tree
Correct expected parameter handling: directly accesses expected.get('sidebar_name') for type='rule'
Logical verification approach: checking for document-frame element with name='Slides View' is valid for LibreOffice Impress
Runtime feasible: accessibility tree getter is reliable, XML parsing is straightforward, no postconfig needed
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider checking explicit visibility attributes (e.g., showing=true, visible=true) in addition to element presence, though LibreOffice typically only includes visible elements in accessibility tree
Consider more specific exception handling instead of generic catch-all to better identify parsing errors
Could add validation that the element actually represents a sidebar panel rather than just checking name match
